author: xHeimskr
body:
Hi my nickname is xHeimskr.
I got banned for autoclicking ( i was using it because i was bored)

I used it for placing blocks.
Now im repentant and i want to be unbanned.

I want to be unbanned because i want to play the new avicus tournament and enjoy ,  the server is looking good 

My ban was true.

I'm a legit player on OCN , i only cheated here , im sorry , I have a YT channel , I upload legit videos , i hope i can be appealed

title: xHeimskr ban appeal

replies.author: gobernment
replies.body: You were punished twice for hacking. You must wait 3 more months before you can appeal your infraction, and that is, if you do not evade your ban on an alternate account. Please be patient and make another in 3 months.
